blocks.content: Rocks serve as the ultimate storehouse of economic minerals, fossil fuels, and soil resources, forming the essential physical backbone of human industrial civilization.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Igneous rocks are major sources of valuable metallic minerals such as iron, magnetic ores, nickel, copper, lead, zinc, gold, and platinum.
Sedimentary rocks host almost all global reserves of fossil fuels including coal, crude petroleum, and natural gas, alongside vital agricultural minerals like phosphate and potash.
Metamorphic rocks yield high-grade economic materials such as marble, slate, graphite, asbestos, quartzite, and precious gemstones.
Building and construction industries rely heavily on dimensional stones derived from rocks, including granite, basalt, sandstone, and limestone.
Weathering of parent rock material forms fertile agricultural soils, directly sustaining primary economic activities.

rows: Metallic ores, structural building stones, road aggregates

Ornamental stones, refractory minerals, industrial lubricants, gemstones

items: Fossil fuels (coal, petroleum, and natural gas) are found exclusively in sedimentary rock strata and never in igneous or high-grade metamorphic rocks.
Igneous rocks are non-fossiliferous and primary sources for metallic mineral deposits generated through magmatic concentration.
frequently tested rock transformation pairs include: Limestone to Marble, Shale to Slate, Sandstone to Quartzite, and Granite to Gneiss.
